name: legal-db
description: Work with the Legal (ליגל) law-office case-management software from Claude: look up clients and cases, and add events, documents, sub-folders and statuses with a preview and explicit approval before every change.
long_description: A local extension for Windows that connects Claude to the Legal case-management software through its database and document folders. Restricted tools only (no general shell): legal_read (look things up), legal_preview (dry-run of a change, returns a one-time token), legal_apply (writes exactly the previewed change), and legal_setup_status / legal_setup_apply for the first-time setup, which runs by itself in the chat on first use. Every write is backed up automatically and verified. Unofficial: not made or supported by the Legal vendor.

tools.name: legal_read
tools.description: Read-only: find clients and cases, show a case with its documents and events, list statuses, event kinds and stages.

tools.name: legal_preview
tools.description: Dry-run of a change in Legal (open a case, add an event or document, rename, move, delete, change status). Writes nothing; returns what would be written and a one-time confirmation token.

tools.name: legal_apply
tools.description: Writes exactly the change that legal_preview showed, identified by its token. Use only after the user explicitly approved the preview.

tools.name: legal_setup_status
tools.description: Shows whether the first-time setup was completed, the work mode and the Legal folder.

tools.name: legal_setup_apply
tools.description: Saves the settings the user chose in the chat (first-time setup or a later change): mode, Legal folder, user name, VAT, event location, backups.
